source_program_semantics.dependency_rule: #k references the zero-indexed result of source operation k
source_program_semantics.power_rule: power(base, exponent) preserves the resolved source exponent
source_program_semantics.semantic_authority: MathQA linear_formula, annotated_formula, source rationale, and standard mathematical operation meaning

downstream_executor_evidence.role: corroborating downstream implementation evidence only; downstream deviations do not override MathQA source semantics

reminder.constraint: resolved arguments are integers and modulus > 1

other_operations: unsupported unless explicitly listed in supported_operations

mismatch_exclusion_reasons.numeric_option_parsing_limitation: program matches a ratio or mixed-number reading not produced by the released first-number option parser
mismatch_exclusion_reasons.strict_tolerance_mismatch: program misses the strict target but is within the downstream executor's approximate one-percent tolerance
mismatch_exclusion_reasons.annotated_formula_linear_formula_disagre: supported annotated_formula matches the selected numeric option but linear_formula does not
mismatch_exclusion_reasons.program_result_matches_other_option: linear_formula result matches a non-selected displayed option
mismatch_exclusion_reasons.source_program_selected_answer_disagreem: linear_formula result and selected numeric option disagree; no repair or causal assertion is made
